pages.text: The $(item)Tremendous Chest$() is a bulk-storage block that holds any mix of items — including enchanted gear and items with custom NBT — in a single large pool. It is the workhorse of most storage setups and connects to the $(l:network/network_interface)item network$() via a tube.

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: $(bold)Storage Upgrade$() — raises the tier and capacity by one step:$(br2)Wood → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Emerald → Netherite$(br2)$(bold)Crafting Upgrade$() — adds a crafting grid to the chest UI.$(br2)$(bold)Magnet Upgrade$() — automatically collects dropped items within 3 blocks.$(br2)$(bold)Puller Upgrade$() — extracts items from adjacent inventories each tick.$(br2)Connect the chest to a tube to make it part of the $(l:network/network_interface)Network$().
